purpose: Reduce excessive two-player ordinary enemy population, preserving other mechanics.

pilot.purpose: Check actual shared-world runner and cost before larger scheduling; not balance evidence.

constraints: Only party population policy differs between game arms; controller and setup remain frozen.
Zero/one living count behavior exact; health/damage/XP/time/boss rules unchanged.
No classifier, Node gameplay, graphical rendering, or network in native campaigns.
Game phases defeat3, victory4, aborted5; horizon is not victory; infrastructure errors never discarded.
Canonical evidence includes each source/artifact/config identity and explicit paired seeds/setup.
Nondefault compiled coefficient arms exercise proved configurable formula; production default25 proofs are not claimed for mutated default constants.
selectionRules: Preferred deployment candidate is extra25 (125 percent for two living players); other development arms are diagnostic controls.
Require all correctness/proof/mutant gates and actual population admission sensitivity to coefficient.
Compare reached60s/reached120s and deaths before30s per seed; worse aggregate survival on validation requires review rather than automatic deployment.
Report level2 reached by60s and XP/progression changes explicitly; no hidden XP compensation.
Compare time-weighted population on common observed prefixes; also report raw coverage and all deaths.
Full-horizon runs are finite regression checks, not proof of late balance if episodes die early.
No candidate selection on final cohort; any use to change next candidate consumes its independence.
telemetryLimits: HP delta is net health, not damage taken.
Current controller is omniscient and not a human population.
No causal attribution from one failure without additional facts.

resourcePolicy.wallBounds: Chosen from measured pilot cost, recorded per launch; timeout remains an infrastructure outcome.
